'''2015 MPC Joe Pinto LS Rendezvous Point''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Pinto]] at [[2015 Match Play Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Joe Pinto]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
